SIND ACT No. VI OF
1930*
[*[For Statement of
Objects and Reasons, see B. G. G., 1930, Part V, pp. 35-38 ; and for

[9th May, 1930]
An Act further to amend the
Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887, in its application to *[Sind].
1. Short title.---This Act
may be called the Provincial Small Cause Courts (*[Sind]
Amendment) Act, 1930.
*[Subs. by the Sind Laws (Adaptation
Revision, Repeal and Declaration) Ordinance, 1955 (Sind 5 of 1955), s. 3 (i)
(w. e. f. 30th May 1951), for Presidency of Bombay".]

sections.shortTitle: Provincial Small Cause Courts Sindh Amendment Act 1930
sections.description:
Amendment of the second Schedule to Act IX of 1887

[THE PROVINCIAL SMALL CAUSE COURTS (SIND AMENDMENT)
[THE PROVINCIAL SMALL CAUSE COURTS (SIND AMENDMENT)
ACT, 1930]
SIND ACT No. VI OF
1930*
[*[For Statement of
Objects and Reasons, see B. G. G., 1930, Part V, pp. 35-38 ; and for
proceedings in Council, see Bombay Legislative Council Debates, 1930, Vol. XXVIII.]]
[9th May, 1930]
An Act further to amend the
Provincial Small Cause Courts Act, 1887, in its application to *[Sind].
3. Amendment of the second
Schedule to Act IX of 1887.--In the Second Schedule to the said Act the
following amendments shall be made, namely:-
(I) to clause
(4) after the words " such property " the following shall be added,
namely:
"but
not including a suit for ejectment where
(a) The property
has been let under a lease made by a written instrument *[or orally], and
*[Ins. in the
principal Act by Sind 9 of 1932, s. 2.]
(b) The Court of Small Causes
would be competent to take cognizance of a suit for the rent of the property,
and
(c) The only
substantial issue arising for decision is as to whether the lease has determined
by efflux of the time limited thereby or has been determined by a notice in
accordance with clause (h) of section III of the Transfer of Property Act,
1882, VI of 1882."
(2) in clause (18) for the words
"relating to a trust" the words " to enforce a trust" shall
be substituted;
(3) to clause (2o) after the
words "Code of Civil Procedure" the words "in respect of any
immoveable property" shall be added ;
(4) to clause (20) after the word
"attachment" the words "of any immoveable property" and
after the word "transfer" the words "of any such property"
shall, respectively, be added; and
(5) in clause (31) for the words
" and a suit for the profits on immoveable property belonging to the
Plaintiff which have been wrongfully received by the Defendant" the words
"but not including a suit for mesne profits" shall be substituted.
